brief.subtitle: Do the homework before you apply or interview — built only from the company's own pages, never AI memory.
brief.urlHint: We fetch this page and build the brief only from what it actually says — people and emails are never guessed.
brief.pageTextPlaceholder: If the page can't be fetched, paste its text here (about page, team page, careers page)…
brief.verify: Verify before you rely on it — everything below comes only from the page you provided, and pages go stale.
brief.ungrounded: This brief is based only on the job description. Add the company's about/careers page URL for a grounded brief.
brief.peopleNote: Only people named on the page you provided — we never guess names, and an email appears only if it's on the page itself.
brief.peopleEmpty: The page names nobody. Try their about/team page, or search LinkedIn directly:
brief.emailOnPage: This address appears on the page you provided
brief.chain: Find the hiring chain on LinkedIn
brief.chainPeopleTab: These open the company's own LinkedIn People tab, filtered by title — real current employees. LinkedIn's country filter is one click away there.
brief.chainSearch: These open a LinkedIn people search for the title at this company. If the company page links its LinkedIn profile, you'll get its People tab instead.
brief.hiringInbox: Hiring inbox found on the page
brief.messageNote: Short, grounded in your résumé, ends with a question. Review it, personalize it — then send it yourself.

health.subtitle: A job-independent grade of your master résumé — writing, evidence, length, gaps. The score is computed by fixed checks, not the AI.
health.scoreNote: Scored by deterministic checks — the AI writes the advice below, never the number.

weak-openers.label: Bullet openers.
weak-openers.issue: {{n}} of {{total}} bullets open with a weak phrase ("responsible for", "helped"):

quantified.label: Evidence & metrics.
quantified.issue: Only {{n}} of {{total}} bullets carry a number — add real metrics where you have them.

buzzwords.label: Buzzwords.
buzzwords.issue: {{n}} buzzwords recruiters read as filler — swap for plain verbs:

long-bullets.label: Bullet length.
long-bullets.issue: {{n}} of {{total}} bullets read as paragraphs — split or trim:

length.label: One-page length.
length.issue: ≈{{n}} words — likely over one page. Cut the weakest bullets first.

gaps.label: Employment gaps.
gaps.ok: No gaps over 6 months between roles.
gaps.issue: {{n}} gap(s) over 6 months — fine, but be ready to explain:

repeated-verbs.label: Verb variety.
repeated-verbs.issue: The same opener starts 3+ bullets — vary the sentence shapes:

health.rewriteNote: Same facts, stronger wording — nothing invented. Apply the ones that sound like you.
